steps: All source fragments are selectable, including unused fragments; unused actor review has no generated instance mappings and cancel preserves every author file.
ADD reviews two fixed explicit placement UUIDs and complete projection/image/group provenance, rejects silent unreviewed raw edits, applies only memory, and ordinary Save changes only the recipe.

REMOVE atomically removes the shared declaration, every placement actor mapping and each local override record, while retaining all groups and unrelated IDs/overrides; cancel and saved reopen preserve the reviewed result.
Unused shared fragments support ordinary saved ADD and REMOVE without placement mappings; deleting their last declared actor remains unavailable and leaves source valid.
Complete candidate dependency checking rejects an unresolved image; ordinary Save detects external writes and preserves both local reviewed source and external disk bytes.
limitations: Real HTTP editor and Chrome only; no installed Tauri window or Android device acceptance.
One recipe shared-fragment actor ADD/REMOVE only; no group editing, placement creation, executable recipe build or cross-file transaction.
